summary: Master the dynamics of Foreign Exchange Markets and Central Bank Intervention. Join our training course to gain insights and elevate your trading expertise.
lede: Foreign exchange hedging helps bank treasury and risk professionals identify currency exposures and choose strategies to reduce their impact. For professionals who advise, manage or oversee FX decisions, the course develops skills in interpreting market drivers, comparing spot, forward and swap instruments, and assessing intervention trade-offs involving liquidity, reserves and financial stability.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals deeply engaged with FX markets or central bank policy in their daily work, seeking to enhance their understanding and influence in currency market dynamics and policy interventions.
audience: Central bank economists, dealers, and policy analysts
Ministry of Finance and Treasury officials
Commercial bank treasury and risk managers
Investment and asset managers with exposure
Corporate finance and treasury managers in FX-exposed
Researchers and analysts in think tanks
modules: FX Instruments and Trading Practices for Policy Makers
Balance of Payments, Capital Flows, and FX Pressures
Objectives and Frameworks for Central Bank FX Intervention
Tools and Operations for FX Intervention
FX Intervention, Monetary Policy, and Financial Stability
Managing FX Volatility, Crises, and Market Dysfunction
FX Risk Management for Public and Private Institutions
Communication, Governance, and Evaluation of Intervention
prerequisites: Participants are expected to have a basic understanding of macroeconomics and financial markets. Previous experience with monetary policy or FX operations is beneficial but not mandatory.
